prompt: A blazing crimson-orange fireball spell hurtling through the air is being unraveled and snuffed out, crumbling into grey ash and dying embers as a lattice of cerulean and sapphire arcane runes wraps around it like a net and crushes it. The dying warm magic sputters against the cold blue counter-energy. The background is a dim stone wizard hall lit only by the cold blue glow of the runes.

A wizard in deep sapphire-blue robes with gold-thread embroidery, side profile facing south-east, his left hand thrust forward palm-out projecting a shattering wall of cerulean runes that breaks an incoming enemy spell-bolt, while his right hand pulls a single glowing parchment card toward himself from a floating open spellbook. The only source of light is the blue arcane glow. The background is a shadowed candlelit stone study.

A swirling cerulean arcane vortex floating in mid-air, a whirlpool of sapphire energy. A hostile crimson spell-bolt is being sucked into the vortex and dissolving, while a single glowing white parchment page spirals outward from the vortex toward the viewer. The background is a dark vaulted stone chamber, the only light is the cold blue swirl of the vortex.

An enemy red-robed sorcerer on the right recoils as his crimson fire spell shatters and crumbles to ash in mid-air, intercepted by a sweeping arc of cerulean counter-magic cast by a blue-robed wizard on the left. Two fully visible figures, the same size, facing each other. The blue wizard gestures sharply; the red sorcerer staggers back. The background is a dim stone dueling hall lit by the clash of blue and dying red light.
